'''December 2001 Milford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milford, MA on 1 December 2001. [[Justin Desai]] won it. It is known from Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3138">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-madskills-at-milford-ma-12-1-01d3138/ madskills-at-milford-ma-12-1-01], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 2 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-madskills-at-milford-ma-12-1-01d3138/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Milford, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Desai]]
